# Code of conduct

[Français](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) · **English**

These rules apply to Bloodborne Legendary Run issues, discussions, and comments.

- Welcome people at every experience level. Discuss feedback and ideas respectfully.
- Keep conversations readable. Avoid spam, repeated posts, and personal attacks.
- Respect other people’s privacy. Keep their contact information, private messages, and account details confidential.
- Warn readers before revealing major game spoilers.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, and sharing personal information can lead to content removal or restrictions on participation.

To report an incident, email [Charles Lindecker](mailto:charles.lindecker@outlook.fr?subject=BBLR%20community%20report) in private. Include a link and enough context to review what happened.
